agedha.p: [Na+gedha] (ti) CL=8 Have no lust, do not lust
a: တပ်မက်ခြင်းမရှိသော။ မတပ်မက်သော၊ သူ။

DOP: 1 gedha m. ( and ~ā, f. ?) and mfn. [ from gijjhati], 1. ( m.f. ) [ cf S. gardha, gṛdhyā, BHS gārdha], greedy, hungry desire; eager longing ; S I 73, 31 (na ca kāmesu ~aṃ āpajjanti); A III 312, 14 (cittaṃ … nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ ~amhā, ~o ti kho bhikkhave pañcann’ etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Sn 65 (rasesu ~aṃ akaraṃ alolo); 945 (~aṃ brūmi mahogho ti; Nidd I 429, 11 : ~o vuccati taṇhā); Thī 352 (~o suvisamo c’ eso mahanto mohanāmukho); Ap 145, 3 (ghāsesu ~am āpanno); Dhs 1059 (icchā mucchā ajjhosānaṃ ~o paḷigedho … ayaṃ vuccati lobho; As 363, 10 : iminā sattā gijjhanti gedhaṃ āpajjantī ti ~o) ≠ Nidd I 8, 15 ; Nett 18, 8 (sekhena dvīsu dhammesu cittaṃ rakkhitabbaṃ ~ā ca rajaniyesu dhammesu dosā ca pariyuṭṭhāniyesu); Dhp-a I 366, 9 (asampattesu patthanāvasena sampattesu °-vasena vividhenākārena āsattacittaṃ); It-a II 147, 3 (appatāya parittāsassa avatthutā, sulabhatāya ~āya avatthutā … dassitā hoti); Sadd 484, 27 (gidhu abhikaṅkhāyaṃ … ~o); — ifc see eta- ( sv eta[d] ); — 2. ( mfn. ) greedy; eagerly longing ; Ap-a 409, 31 (migānaṃ māraṇe luddo lobhī ~o ti migaluddo, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce chedako ti); — agedha , m. , absence of greed; freedom from greed ; Mil 276, 9 (~-tā nirālayatā cāgo …); Vism 465, 7 (alobho ārammaṇe cittassa ~-lakkhano); — see also giddhi, gedhi.
CPD: a-gedha , mfn. , not greedy; hence a-gedhatā , f. abstr. , Mil 276, 9 (+ nirālayatā, cāgo, etc. ). — ° -lakkhaṇa , mfn. , characterized by absence of greed , As 127, 18 .

agedhatā.p: [Agedha+tā] (thī) CL=10 Being someone without lust. No lust.
a: တပ်မက်ခြင်း မရှိသူ၏အဖြစ်။ မတပ်မက်ခြင်း။

ageha.p: [Na+geha] (ti) CL=9 Not having a home. Does not have a home that is lust. A person without a home, without a home of lust. See agaha
a: အိမ်မရှိသော။ တဏှာတည်းဟူသော အိမ်မရှိသော၊ သူ။ အဂဟ-ကြည့်။

DOP: 1 geha n. ( pl. nom. ~āni, ~ā) [ AMg id.; S. gṛha, geha], a house, a dwelling; a shelter; a home, a household; esp. the dwelling of a layman, living a worldly life in a family ; Abh 207 (~aṃ); Vin III 16, 7 (nanu nāma tāta Sudinna sakaṃ ~aṃ gantabban ti); D II 244, 2* (yaṃ ca sutvā jahāsi no ~e amhe ca kevale); III 155, 13* (~am āvasati ca tathāvidho); M II 62, 27 (kuto no … amhākaṃ ~aṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ); Dhp 154 (gahakāraka diṭṭho si, puna ~aṃ na kāhasi; Dhp-a III 128, 20 : puna imasmiṃ saṃsāravaṭṭe attabhāvasaṅkhātaṃ mama ~aṃ na kāhasi) = Th 184; Pv 15:22 (āpaṇā ~am ehiti); 29:4 (musāvādena chādemi natthi etaṃ mama ~e); Th 111 (duppabbajjaṃ ve duradhivasā ~ā); Ja I 145, 20 (~e anabhiratā pabbajitukāmā hutvā); 290, 27 (purohitassa ~aṃ sattabhūmakaṃ sattadvārakoṭṭhakaṃ hoti); 355, 7* (daḍḍhāni ~āni jano ca nīto); II 18, 9 (ekabhūmika-dvibhūmikādibhede ~e sajjetvā, Ce, Ee so; Be geha-sambhāre; Se pāsāde); IV 477, 19* (adhicca vede pariyesa vittaṃ putte ~e tāta patiṭṭhapetvā); Ap 160, 12 (yaṃ me atthi sake ~e āmisaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ tāhaṃ buddhassa pādāsiṃ); Cp 3:3:4 (sattā … nirārakkhā sake ~e vaḍḍhanti sakañātibhi); 3:5:3 (kadā ’haṃ ~ā nikkhamma pavisissāmi kānanaṃ); Mil 396, 24 (gorūpo sakaṃ ~aṃ na vijahati); Sp 282, 10 (ekakuḍḍake ~e); 573, 18 (mahantaṃ pi tiṇacchadanaṃ ~aṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, ullittādibhāvo eva hi kuṭiyā lakkhaṇaṃ); Ps IV 111, 15 (bodhi-atthaṃ hi ~aṃ na gehatthāya bodhi); Dhp-a I 151, 4 (devasikaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ~e dve bhikkhu-sahassāni bhuñjanti); Ap-a 58, 19 (atthi nu kho amma kiñci ~asmiṃ dānaṃ dassāmī ti); Cp-a 133, 22 (nikkhamanāya ~ato nikkhami pabbajī ti attho); Sadd 861, 10 (taṃ taṃ vatthuṃ gaṇhātī ti ~aṃ, ~o ti pi pulliṅgaṃ icchanti); — ifc see cora- ( sv cora 1 ), jara- ( sv jara 1 ), tāpana-, dhura-, pacchā-, pacchima-; — °- cchādaka , m. [geha + chādaka 1 ], a roofer ; Sp 562, 27 (chadanatthāya ~ānaṃ [santikaṃ gantvā], Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-chādanakānaṃ); — °- jana , m. [geha + jana 1 ], (a member of) the household; the servants ; Ja II 347, 10 (~aṃ tajjentī paharantī carati); Dhp-a I 72, 6 (~ā tena saddhiṃ parihāsaṃ karontā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr paribhāsaṃ karonto); Pv-a 16, 26 (taṃ rodantiṃ koci pi ~o saññāpetuṃ nāsakkhi); — °- jjhāyana , °-jjhāna, n. [geha + jhāyana 1 , jhāna 2 ], the burning of a house ; Ja I 347, 21 (~-bhayena, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-jjhāna-) = Dhp-a I 370, 18 ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce gehaṃ jhāyanabhayena); — ° - (j)jhāpana , n. , house-burning ; Vism 326, 23 ( in cpd ); — °- dāsī , f. , a female house-slave ; Sp 361, 13 (~iyā kucchismiṃ dāsassa jāto antojātako); Vibh-a 441, 24 ; Sadd 261, 1 ; — °- nissita 2 , mfn. , connected with, attached to, rooted in, the household (sensual) life ; A II 14, 5* (yo vitakkaṃ vitakketi pāpakaṃ ~aṃ; Mp III 16, 17 : ~an ti kilesanissitaṃ) = It 117, 17* (It-a II 174, 36 foll. : ~an ti ettha gehavāsīhi apariccattattā gehavāsīnaṃ sabhāvattā gehadhammattā vā gehaṃ vuccati vatthukāmo, atha vā gehapaṭibaddhabhāvato kilesakāmānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhāna-bhāvato taṃvatthukattā vā kāmavitakkādi ~aṃ nāma); Sn 280 (yaṃ evarūpaṃ jānātha … ~aṃ pāpicchaṃ; Pj II 311, 13 foll. : yaṃ evarūpaṃ pañcakāmaguṇanissitaṃ jāneyyātha); Ap 438, 7 (yadā kilesā jāyanti vitakkā ~ā); Mil 45, 27 (cha-y-imāni mahārāja ~āni somanassāni cha nekkhammanissitāni …); — °- (p)pavesana , n. ,, °-(p)pavesa, m. ,, entering a house ; Ja II 169, 1 (itarassa ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-ppavesaṃ); Ap-a 256, 37 (tassā saha ~ena); — ~-maṅgala, n. , the ceremony of entering a new house ; Dhp-a III 307, 13 (gehaṃ kāretvā ~-maṅgalaṃ ca chattamaṅgalaṃ ca ekato va karonto); Nidd-a I 416, 2 (~-maṅgalaṃ kātabbaṃ, Se so; Be °-ppavesa-; Ce, Ee gahappavesamaṅgalaṃ); — °- pema , n. , affection rooted in (and appropriate only to) the household (sensual) life ; Vin-vn 1979 (bhikkhuno methuno rāgo ~aṃ pi vā bhave); — °- rakkhaka , mf (-ikā) n. , guarding the house ; Spk I 165, 3 (~e dārake vā mātugāme vā ṭhapetvā); Dhp-a IV 103, 25 (ekam eva dāsiṃ °-rakkhikaṃ ṭhapetvā); — °- rakkhaṇa , °- rakkhana , n. , protecting the house; guarding the house ; Ps IV 111, 14 (~’-atthaṃ); — °- rakkhaṇaka , mfn. , guarding the house ; Vv-a 76, 20 (~-dārake, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee geharakkhike dārake, prob. wr ); — °- lañchaka , ? (yāni cha ~āni domanassāni … taṇhāpakkho, taṇhāya etaṃ vevacanaṃ … yā cha upekkhā ~ā ayaṃ diṭṭhi-pakkho); Vism 318, 24 ; Ps III 132, 13 (attabhāvaṃ nissāya ~aṃ chandarāgaṃ uppādesi); 372, 19 (kin nu kho samaṇo Gotamo ~-vasena parisaṃ ussādento vā apasādento vā dhammaṃ deseti udāhu no ti); — ~-pema, n. , affection rooted in (and appropriate only to) a household life ; Sp 211, 9 (tātā ti vacanaṃ ~-pemena āha na samaṇa-tejena … gahapatī ti idaṃ pana vacanaṃ samaṇatejen’ āha); 541, 29 (ayaṃ me mātā ayaṃ dhītā ayaṃ bhaginī ti ~-pemena āmasato pi dukkaṭam eva); 902, 19 (purisassa methunarāgo vā ~-pemaṃ vā suddhacittaṃ vā hotu); Ps II 9, 11 (amhākaṃ ācariyo amhākaṃ upajjhāyo ti ~-pemaṃ hoti); It-a II 69, 27 ; — ageha , mfn. , homeless, without a house ; Ja II 423, 3´ (~o pabbajito hutvā); Spk I 291, 32 (aniketā ~ā bhikkhavo); Pj II 403, 1 (agiho ti ~o, nittaṇho ti adhippāyo, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se agaho ti); — niggeha , mfn. , homeless, without a house ; Spk I 106, 1 (anagāriyaṃ ~-bhāvaṃ upetassa); — sageha , mfn. , with the houses ;?
